summary_en: ¥34.0B upper limit, 6,420,000 shares (2.0% of shares outstanding), open-market purchase via ToSTNeT-3, period 19 Aug – 30 Nov 2026. Rationale: mitigate near-term supply pressure from Hitachi Ltd.'s planned sale of 21.46M shares; strengthen shareholder returns and improve ROE and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Relating to Acquisition of Own Shares
translation_en_brief: On 18 August 2026, Hitachi Ltd. notified Hitachi Construction Machinery that it intends to sell 21.46 million shares of the company. In response, the board resolved on 18 August 2026 to acquire up to 6.42 million shares (approximately 30% of the announced sale volume) via open-market purchase under a discretionary trading method over the period 19 August to 30 November 2026, with a yen budget ceiling of ¥34.0 billion. The acquisition is intended to mitigate near-term supply pressure on the stock from Hitachi Ltd.'s sale, strengthen shareholder returns, and improve ROE and capital efficiency. Acquisition may be partial or zero depending on investment opportunities and market conditions. The shares outstanding denominator (excluding treasury) used to compute the 2.0% figure is not explicitly stated in the filing; the percentage is derived from 6,420,000 ÷ ~321M.
